sources.name: Places and local business data
sources.candidates: OpenStreetMap via Overpass or a bulk extract is openly licensed under ODbL and is the only candidate with unrestricted commercial reuse. Foursquare Places has an open data release. Google Places forbids storing and displaying most fields, so it cannot back a published page.
sources.licenceRisk: ODbL requires attribution and share alike on derived databases, which has to be read properly before a page is generated from it.
sources.coverage: OSM POI density varies by city by an order of magnitude; the gate in lib/atlas/poi-gate.js is what stops that becoming thin pages.
sources.rateLimits: Overpass is rate limited and unsuitable for bulk; a planet or regional extract is the realistic path.

sources.name: Stay inventory and prices

sources.attribution: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project, funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program
sources.caveat: Modelled values for a 0.5 by 0.625 degree grid cell (MERRA-2 based), stated as such on the page. Only T2M is a monthly normal: T2M_MAX and T2M_MIN on this endpoint are the extremes over the whole period, are stored as tmaxExtreme and tminExtreme, and are never scored or presented as a typical day.
